title: Reinstating a Defaulted Repayment Plan — Benefit Overpayment Accounts
content:
A claimant whose repayment plan on one of the Benefit Overpayment Accounts has defaulted may have the plan reinstated. The reinstated plan returns to current standing and carries exactly the reinstated monthly installment worked out for it, keeping its first installment due date and the classification's due day.

## When a defaulted plan is reinstated

A defaulted plan is not reinstated until a repayment at least equal to the arrears payment worked out for it has been booked on the overpayment after the plan's most recent returned installment.

The overpayment's ledger is the record that shows it: a repayment entry dated after the plan's most recent return entry, for an amount at least equal to the arrears payment worked out for the plan. Without such an entry the plan stays defaulted.

## What reinstatement records

Reinstatement changes the plan status on the overpayment record from defaulted to current and replaces the plan's monthly installment with the reinstated installment. The due date of the plan's opening installment and the monthly due day stay as they were.

| Item on the overpayment record | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Repayment plan status | Defaulted | Current |
| Monthly installment | The defaulted plan's installment | The reinstated monthly installment |
| Due date of the opening installment | Unchanged | Unchanged |

## The reinstatement tool

Reinstatement is made with `reinstate_repayment_plan_54c54ed5`, a tool that belongs to the claimant, by which the claimant agrees to have the defaulted plan put back in force. The representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `overpayment_id` | The reference number of the benefit overpayment whose plan is reinstated, as given to the claimant by the representative from the overpayment record | Reference number |
| `monthly_amount` | The reinstated monthly installment, as the representative states it | USD, 2 decimal places (0.00 when no plan); an amount with more decimals is rounded to the nearest cent when recorded |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows `overpayment_id`, `repayment_plan_status` (current when the plan was reinstated), `repayment_plan_monthly_amount` (the installment recorded, USD to 2 decimal places) and `repayment_plan_start_date` (the due date of the plan's opening installment, YYYY-MM-DD, unchanged). A receipt showing the status current means the plan is reinstated. If the overpayment reference number matches no overpayment, the reply starts with "Error:" and nothing changes.

*Illustration (hypothetical values):* reinstating overpayment OP-3310 at 64.17 returns `repayment_plan_status` current, `repayment_plan_monthly_amount` 64.17 and the opening due date the plan already had.
